name: smwgraphics-super-robot-taisen-original-generation-mission-41-ryusei-part
title: Super Robot Taisen: Original Generation - Mission 41 (Ryusei) Part 2
description:
The map of the second part of the Mission 41 (Ryusei) in Super Robot Taisen: Original Generation (GBA), re-arranged (and edited a bit) as a background.

This is a HUGE background: basically every color besides Status Bar's and first half of palettes 2 and 6 are used, and only FG1 and FG3 are free to use. Keep this in mind. Also note that this background is 32x24 and doesn't loop, so it works best with a custom scroll setting (as Variable 3 or 4 for both horizontal and vertical scroll).
